title: Podcast Queue Snapshot Failure Rate
dataSources: AntennaPod episodes (`antennapod:episode`), Audible listening sessions (`audible:listen`), Goodreads audiobooks (`goodreads:audiobook`), podcast queues (`podcast:queue`), and listening streaks (`listen:streak`).
app: AntennaPod listening exports, Audible progress logs, Goodreads audiobook shelves, podcast queue snapshots, and listening streak counters ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=podcast:queue
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(queue_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by queue_name
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often podcast queue snapshot records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each queue.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize queue_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per queue.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It turns which parts of your podcast queue snapshot data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
